description: This source file defines API route handlers for creating and deleting Credential records related to delegation credentials within an organization, specifically supporting Google Calendar credentials. It includes functions for validation, credential creation, deletion, and request handling.

methods.name: handleCreateCredentials
methods.description: Creates credentials for organization members with delegation credentials enabled, supporting Google Calendar, handling batching and logging.

methods.name: handleDeleteCredentials
methods.description: Deletes credentials associated with disabled delegation credentials, supporting Google Calendar, with logging.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming request authorization based on API key.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Main request handler that executes create and delete credential functions and returns a combined response.
